summary: Managed deployments need an MDM server to provision configurations, certificates, identities and passwords to an app. BifrOSt keeps app secrets in its keychain and passwords store and has a personal VPN model, but it has no administrator provisioning path, so an app cannot receive managed values. iPadOS 18.4 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: No provisioned configuration reaches an app.

features.apple: Specifying and decoding a configuration, ManagedAppConfigurationDecodingError
features.note: No decoder or validation path for administrator values.
trust.rs evaluates certificate chains; it does not receive provisioned certificates.
The passwords group is the user's own; nothing is pushed by an administrator.

gaps: No administrator provisioning path (MDM) for configurations, certificates, identities or passwords.
The keychain and passwords store keep the user's secrets only; they are not managed.
